source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Developing Responsible Technology under 8.4 as printed (PDF 118, printed 114).

blocks.text: Responsible innovation means focusing on human welfare rather than only financial gains. Technologies should be developed to improve quality of life, create opportunities, and minimize harm. When designing systems, developers must consider the long-term social and environmental impacts, ensuring that technology benefits communities equitably.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: The best technologies put people first, ethics and empathy are key ingredients in innovation.
